checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
Named exports only — no default exports
Chips must use aria-pressed for toggle state

SR-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ChipBar component that renders a row of filter chips. Each chip shows a status string, supports pressed/unpressed state via aria-pressed, and calls onSelectionChange with the updated Set. Include the CSS file with the component.
SR-01.output:
The `ChipBar` component is written. Here's what was created:

**`ChipBar.tsx`**
- Accepts `statuses: string[]`, `selected: Set<string>`, and `onSelectionChange: (next: Set<string>) => void`
- Renders a `<div role="group">` containing one `<button>` per status
- Each button has `aria-pressed={selected.has(status)}` — toggled on click
- On click, builds a new `Set` (immutable update) and calls `onSelectionChange`

**`ChipBar.css`**
- Component-tier tokens: `--shelf-chip-bgColor-*`, `--shelf-chip-fgColor-*`, `--shelf-chip-borderColor-*` defined in all three theme blocks (`:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, `@media prefers-color-scheme: dark`)
- `appearance: none` + explicit `background-color` on every button state
- Only `transform` and `opacity` animated
- Kebab-case class names

**`tokens.css`** — bootstrapped with the required semantic tokens referenced by the component aliases.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
